generation.scope: An integral reduced sextic point graph with disjoint finite residual can only be a singular canonical plane quartic of normalization genus zero or one, without finite residual. Nonplanar singularities, all hyperelliptic models and normalization genus two are excluded. Any nonidentity canonical four-shift is a plane homology of order two or four, with trivial squared polarization difference.

open_mathematics: Solve the rational and elliptic normalization strata of canonical plane quartic sextic models. Use the two moving trisecant points and canonical fixed-ideal conditions, then continue the outstanding general AS and global coverage problems.
